project.title: PROJECT ZONE
project.description: PROJECT ZONE is an independent Unity 6 URP open-zone FPS RPG. Explore a dangerous exclusion zone, fight hostiles, scavenge gear, complete contracts, and return to safety. Performance-first: 120–150+ FPS typical, 100 FPS floor on reference hardware. Built with HQ FPS Weapons 2.0 and Emerald AI 2026, bridged by Project Zone adapters.
